name: Pure White
source:
Pure White is about a boy and his sister who've just lost their father. They retreat to the town of their youth to give them time to get back on their (emotional) feet.

[From [url=http://www.renai.us/game/purewhite.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
《Pure White》讲述一名男孩与妹妹刚失去父亲后，回到儿时生活的城镇，借此重新振作的故事。

[摘自[url=http://www.renai.us/game/purewhite.shtml]Ren’Ai Archive[/url]]
